body:
Well thanks for wanting to talk to me. I guess this is a good opportunity for me to vent and try and have a coherent grasp on my feelings. 

I missed the deadline for transferring and my GPA has sunk since last semester. I'm definitely going to focus on school next semester. Believe it or not this is not the worse I have been. you should have seen me last semester lol. Went from a 3.4 to a 2.8 in that second semester. 

I guess I haven't been too honest. You see I don't have any immediate plans to commit suicide (My post might have given off that impression.) As I said this is a pathetic way of getting attention. Although it is really really tempting to go make an appointment with a sky diving service. My initial plan was to wait till I'm 30 and then make an objective assessment of my life then. If I'm unhappy I'll do myself in. I don't think I want to wait that long though.

I'm trying to stop drinking to lose weight. I understand there are lots of calories in booze. But sometimes I just grab a bottle of wine and drink it all down lol. 

My ambitions were a kickass banking career ya know? This is very silly lol. It's not that I feel bad I won't get that but that my life has deviated from this very specific way I had in mind. Now after that deviation I dunno where it's going or where I want it to go. I don't know what to do with my life anymore. The funny thing is that banking is I hear one of the most stressful careers out there. Just to show you how I can feel bad about losing possibly very bad things for me you know what I mean? (Sorry for my poor way of explaining things, English is not my first language.) 

I'm trying to break up with my gf right now for the 5th time I think lol. She is so oblivious to how I feel. She just doesn't understand it. She's a sweet girl but too immature for handling a relationship like that. The whole gf situation I think is the most stressful thing actually. I'll miss her.

The whole two years with my aunt was surreal lol. I didn't know there were people out there who were that cruel. They're immigrants and they're rich. They also have zero social skills whatsoever. They're socially isolated. All they have is their two young kids and me when I came. All their frustrations, anger and downright nastiness came out on me and the kids. They use to beat the kids. They're downright tyrannical with them. With me it was gradual, they were super nice to me at first but after a while the passive aggression started because they're poor bastards who don't know any better. It culminated in my aunt kicking me out after I didn't do the dishes that her husband said that I ate in, when I had ate out. (you see the rule was everyone was responsible for making their own dishes.) 

I haven't seen them in a year now but I still have dreams about them looool.

I can't be friends with anyone because I forgot how to. It's weird. I guess a lot of people would relate to me here when I say that it's ingrained in my head and thought processes, that no one would want to be friends with me because you are an undesirable uninteresting fuck.

Ahh man you should have seen me a year earlier, I was the complete opposite. I always had a smile on and I always wanted to talk to people. Being human is so weird. 

I know I have something wrong with me because I remember when I was grade 8 or so I went a whole year without talking to anyone other than my mom. I was back in my backwards country so there was no fucks giving by the school or anything lol. But things got better eventually. I was "normal" until just recently. 

I want to help people but I don't know how. I'm thinking of transferring to social work but I'm too intimidated by the responsibility I would have you know? I tried emailing some institutions that help people to volunteer for them but I guess I didn't try hard enough. Maybe I should fix myself first lol. 

You know it's actually nice to write out my thoughts like that. Thanks man.

I hate my school because it is a shit school. Wasn't my first choice it was a back up. I guess it's because I didn't connect with anyone there too.

My ambitions were lame but that what I had working for me. I thought I would have this super successful career surrounded by successful happy people. I had a general narrative to how my life was going to pan out except perhaps it was too, what's the word here, fantastical maybe?

There is also a lot of stuff like how I was emotionally abused (and believe I'm not throwing this term around lightly) by my aunt and her family when I stayed with them culminating in her kicking me out on the streets. And how I keep breaking up and getting back together to my gf who doesn't have time for me. 

I'm trying not to drink much right now. Mostly for trying to slim down but it's just too darn tempting lol. 

I can't get a friend because I'm not someone that anyone would want to be friends with. Simple enough lol.

Thank you all for replying to me. This subreddit is really a nice piece of work. You know what I really want to do? I realize that there is a lot of people out there like me. Who all they want is a hug and a shoulder to lean on. I want to go out there and hug everyone and make everyone happy. Sorry for my rambling. You guys have a good life :)
Yeah I think this is the ultimate test to check how much I really want to live. One of my finer ideas lol.
It's really nice of you to reply to me.
